summary: Open-source parts of Modular's AI platform: the Mojo programming language and the MAX framework for fast model inference on CPUs and GPUs.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: This repository holds the open-source components of the Modular Platform. Mojo is a programming language for high-performance AI code, and MAX is a framework for building and serving models, including GPU programming abstractions, compute kernels, a graph compiler, a runtime, Python model authoring, model pipelines and an OpenAI-compatible inference server.
sixtySeconds.problem: Getting AI models to run fast across different hardware usually means vendor-specific code. Modular aims to give one platform for writing kernels and serving models.
whoFor: Teams serving models with an OpenAI-compatible endpoint
People interested in the Mojo language
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it to work with Mojo and MAX source directly, run examples from the repo or contribute to them.
requirements: For your own projects: follow the MAX and Mojo get-started guides
For text generation with MAX: a compatible GPU

overview: To use MAX and Mojo in your own projects, the README points to the official MAX get-started guide and the Mojo quickstart rather than listing install commands.

To experiment from the repository, use the bundled bazelw wrapper: run mojo on an example file, or run the MAX pipelines entrypoint to generate text with a model such as Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B (needs a compatible GPU).
Mojo is Apache 2.0 with LLVM Exceptions. Parts of MAX are under the separate MAX license, and the rest under Apache 2.0 with LLVM Exceptions.
strengths: One stack from kernels to serving
limitations: Install steps live in external docs
Part of MAX uses a custom license

install.verificationNote: Commands come from Modular Platform (MAX and Mojo)'s README. AIRepoHub hasn't run them yet.
prerequisites: A compatible GPU for MAX generation

steps.title: Follow the official guides
steps.body: Use the MAX get-started guide (max.modular.com/get-started) and the Mojo quickstart (mojolang.org/docs/manual/quickstart/).

steps.title: Generate text with MAX
steps.code:
./bazelw run //max/python/max/_entrypoints:pipelines -- generate \
  --model Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B --max-batch-size 1 --max-length 8000 \
  --prompt "The sky is blue because"

firstRun.title: Run hello.mojo
firstRun.body: Use the bazelw command from the repo.

tutorial.title: Generate text with MAX from the repository

steps.title: Run the pipelines entrypoint
steps.code: ./bazelw run //max/python/max/_entrypoints:pipelines -- generate --model Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B --max-batch-size 1 --max-length 8000 --prompt "The sky is blue because"

tutorial.expected: Generated text printed in the terminal.
